content: A {{Senior Frontend}} software engineer from the {{Philippines}}.
Most of my professional experience is focused on {{mobile}} and {{frontend}} development, with Flutter as my main strength.
I’ve also worked with {{React}}, {{Next.js}}, and modern web technologies to build scalable products.
I have strong experience in {{application architecture}}, {{state management}}, and building maintainable systems for growing products.
I enjoy taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical decisions to production delivery.
I’ve led frontend development in startup environments, including owning {{frontend infrastructure}} and {{cloud hosting}} setups.
I value clean code, clear communication, and building products that solve real problems.
